cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The birthday invitations failed address verification. Get out the checklist I taught you to use; we need to mark the stage that let us down.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wrote our old address on every envelope.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Well spotted. The archive supplied an outdated location and verification missed it. Two headings, please; you used to put everything under 'mistake'.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You keep the address book and posted them. Who's calling the guests?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll do notifications. Add that third heading, and put 'insufficient staffing' across all three. You can see now why I taught you to separate functions.

reason: Replace generic teaching tags with exact trained habits and corrections that shape the Drive pursuit. Keep B concerns concrete and each A response tied to new B information.
